data.text: There is an unresolved rivalry over whether the log requires RFC 9110 idempotence simpliciter or a stronger, log-specific property. One position holds that the log requires idempotence in the RFC sense; the opposing position holds that the log requires a property distinct from or strictly stronger than RFC idempotence, because RFC 9110 idempotence is order-insensitive and defined over individual HTTP method semantics rather than over ordered sequences of operations with causality.
